Thanks for reporting. A few checks first, so the report can be acted on:

1. Use a dump of your own disc that matches Redump (the names in OGBox's game database are
   Redump's). A bad or modified dump causes faults OGBox can't fix.
2. Try the game with every mod, cheat or trainer and XBE patch turned off (and default settings,
   if you can), and say below whether it still happens.
3. Attach ogbox-boot.log from the title folder. If it wasn't a crash, choose Save the Log in the
   quick menu first. After a crash, copy ogbox-boot.log and ogbox-boot.previous.log before you
   start OGBox again.

Never attach or link game files, BIOS files or keys.
-->
